## v1.6.0

Changes since `v1.5.1`:

- Release 1.6.0 (9c97361)
- Update docs for K3.1 Pro and OpenCode v1 (c4986c0)
- Add K3.1 Pro model support (9466e95)
- Document postponed kimi-code migration (a9e1712)
- Add Simplified Chinese README (3595d78)

**Full diff:** https://github.com/yixiaosz/opencode-kimi-oauth/compare/v1.5.1...v1.6.0

- Support Kimi K2.8 Preview, K3, K3-256K, and K2.7 Code HighSpeed.
- Fix `/kimi:usage` not found for npm installs.
